text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru doesn't show up for
training,
so I go and look for her...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The omen to beware of lightning...
again?! But
why? It's so sunny outside...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Upon closer inspection... Th-those
clouds look
kind of menacing, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
choice_data_list: トレーニング、忘れてないか？
トレーニング、忘れてない？
choice_data_list_en: Haven't forgotten about training, have you?
Haven't forgotten about training, have you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give her a storm of a scolding so this
doesn't
happen again.
